meta.name: how-it-works
meta.description: Explain how claude-mem captures observations, when memory injection kicks in, and where data lives. Use when the user asks "how does claude-mem work?" or "what is this thing doing?".

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能讲解 claude-mem 的运作方式:每次读文件、编辑或运行命令都会变成一条浓缩记录,这些记录在会话结束时做汇总;以后相关的记录会自动带入新对话,不用从头讲。它也会说明数据保存在本机。
howto.when: 当用户问「claude-mem 是怎么工作的?」或「它到底在做什么?」时触发。

say.text: 给我讲讲 claude-mem 是怎么工作的?
say.note: 会讲清记录、汇总与自动带入的机制。
会说明它的用途和行为。
会指出本机的数据存放位置。

howto.what_en: Claude can explain how claude-mem works: every file read, edit, or command becomes a condensed observation, summed up when the session ends; relevant ones are later auto-injected into new chats. It also says where data lives.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks "how does claude-mem work?" or "what is this thing doing?".

say_en.text: Where does claude-mem store its memories?
say_en.note: Points to the local data directory.
